# openwebui_knowledge_file (Resource)

Attaches an uploaded file to a knowledge base. Destroying this resource detaches the file; set `delete_file = true` to also delete the underlying file.

~> **Note:** `delete_file = true` only deletes the underlying file if the caller (the provider's configured token) owns the file, or is an admin. Otherwise the detach still succeeds but the underlying file deletion is silently skipped by Open WebUI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openwebui_file" "doc" {
  source_path = "${path.module}/files/faq.pdf"
  process     = true
}

resource "openwebui_knowledge" "faq" {
  name        = "Support FAQ"
  description = "Knowledge base backing the support chatbot"
}

resource "openwebui_knowledge_file" "example" {
  knowledge_id = openwebui_knowledge.faq.id
  file_id      = openwebui_file.doc.id
  delete_file  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_id` (String) UUID of the file to attach (from `openwebui_file.id`). Forces replacement.
- `knowledge_id` (String) UUID of the knowledge base to attach the file to. Forces replacement.

### Optional

- `delete_file` (Boolean) When `true`, the underlying file is deleted when this resource is destroyed. Defaults to `false`. Deletion only takes effect if the caller owns the file or is an admin; otherwise this silently no-ops.

### Read-Only

- `file_json` (String) JSON representation of the attached file entry as returned by Open WebUI.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form `knowledge_id:file_id`.
